app.title: Concord
app.crash.title: Concord couldn’t display this window.
app.crash.body: An internal error interrupted the display. Reloading the window usually fixes it; if it happens again, reinstall the latest version.
app.nickname.label: Display name
app.nickname.help: Visible to the other people on your local network.
app.avatar.label: Avatar
app.avatar.help: Pick a drawing or an image from your computer. Nothing goes to the Internet: your avatar stays on your computer and travels only on the local network.
app.avatar.upload.error.unreadable: This file could not be read.
discovery.state.searching: Looking for rooms on your local network…
discovery.state.searchingHint: A busy network can take a few seconds.
discovery.empty.title: No rooms yet.
discovery.empty.body: Create a room on this machine, or wait for someone nearby to open one.
discovery.offline.title: No active network
discovery.offline.body: You can create a room on this machine and talk in it. It will become visible to others as soon as a network interface is connected.
discovery.error.mdns.title: mDNS discovery unavailable
discovery.error.mdns.body: Automatically falling back to UDP broadcast scanning (port 47820). Rooms stay discoverable.
discovery.error.alldown.title: Discovery unavailable
discovery.footer.searching: Looking for rooms on the local network…
discovery.footer.offline: Offline — the list fills in as soon as a network is available.
discovery.footer.port.none: No room open on this machine.
discovery.join.matching: A room already has this name on the network — join it instead of creating a second one.
discovery.state.empty.offline: No rooms: you are offline. You can still create a room on this machine.
room.list.title: Rooms on the local network
room.create.nameHelp: Visible on the local network. 32 characters maximum.
room.create.error.exists: A room is already open on this machine.
room.empty.title: The room is empty
room.empty.body: Nobody is connected to “{{name}}” any more.
settings.title: Settings
settings.audio.inputNoneHelp: Plug in a microphone, then reopen this panel.
settings.audio.outputNoneHelp: Plug in a headset or speaker, then reopen this panel.
settings.audio.aecHelp: Actual state read from the device, not the requested value.
settings.audio.modeHelp: Push to talk transmits only while held. Voice detection opens the mic above the threshold.
settings.audio.duck.help: While someone speaks to you, other apps quietly turn down and come back after.
settings.vad.title: Voice detection
settings.vad.help: Keep the threshold above ambient noise and below your voice.
settings.ptt.title: Push to talk
settings.ptt.recording: Press a key combination… (Esc to cancel)
settings.ptt.conflict: {{shortcut}} is already taken by the system. The previous shortcut ({{previous}}) stays active.
settings.ptt.needModifier: The combination must include Ctrl, Alt or Shift.
settings.ptt.globalHelp: Works even when the window is not focused.
settings.overlay.disabledHint: Enable the overlay to adjust its opacity and size.
settings.overlay.help: The overlay never takes focus and lets clicks through; only its handle responds to the mouse.
settings.network.name: Name shown on the network
settings.network.externalHelp: No STUN, no TURN, no server outside the local network.
settings.network.identityHelp: Ephemeral identifier, regenerated at every launch. No account, no history.
settings.about.local: Your settings stay on this machine.
voice.unavailable.title: Voice could not start
voice.link.absent: No signalling pipe is open: peers cannot hear each other.
voice.link.connecting: Signalling: connecting to the local link…
voice.peers.title: Remote peers
update.settings.help: Concord checks the official GitHub releases; nothing else leaves your network.
